headline: Cognition launches SWE-2, intensifying AI coding model competition
body: Cognition released its new SWE-2 model this week, positioning itself directly against Anthropic's Claude 5.1 and OpenAI's GPT-Astra in the software engineering AI space. For healthcare AI, this matters because coding models underpin the infrastructure for clinical decision support systems, EHR integrations, and rapid deployment of AI workflows in health systems. As vendors compete on model capability, healthcare organizations should evaluate how these advances translate to faster development of compliant, auditable AI solutions for their specific clinical needs. The velocity of this competition suggests healthcare AI tooling will see accelerated iteration cycles and competitive pricing pressures in 2025.
